# NutriZen

> Premium natural supplements formulated for real results. Transparent ingredients, high-quality bioavailable nutrient forms, and targeted support for your wellness goals. Delivered across South Africa.

NutriZen is an online supplement brand based in South Africa. We sell premium, scientifically formulated nutritional supplements with a focus on ingredient transparency, bioavailability, and purposeful dosing.

## What we sell

- **Immune support** – formulas targeting immune resilience with vitamins C, D3, zinc, and elderberry
- **Magnesium Complex** – magnesium in highly absorbable forms (bisglycinate, malate) for sleep, muscle function, and stress support
- **Vitamin D3** – cholecalciferol for bone health, immunity, and mood
- **Iron** – gentle, bioavailable iron for energy and haemoglobin support
- **Glutathione** – master antioxidant for cellular health
- **Para Cleanse** – herbal-based digestive support formula
- **Adaptogen blends** – stress and cortisol support formulas
- **Combo packs** – bundled supplement stacks (e.g. Immunity Power Pack)

## Brand values

- **Transparency** – every ingredient listed with its form and purpose
- **Bioavailability first** – nutrient forms chosen for absorption, not cost
- **Targeted formulas** – supplements built around specific health goals
- **No proprietary blends** – no hidden stacks or filler-heavy formulas
- **Evidence-aligned dosing** – amounts grounded in published research

- Delivers nationwide across South Africa
- Response time: 1–2 business days, Monday to Friday
